claim_boundary: A two-window pass supports only a replicated net-of-taker-fee one-day cross-sectional reversal spread on Binance USDT perpetuals at a bar-open execution proxy over two reused historical calendars. Familywise-error language is scoped to post-policy cycles only. It does not establish causality, deployability, capacity, slippage-inclusive profitability, funding-inclusive profitability, or an absolute breakthrough, and nothing here bears on the 40% annual-return aspiration.

diagnostics.non_claim: Descriptive only. The gross spread (no fees); the one-hour-lagged net spread (entry at the h=1 bar open of day d; exit at the h=1 bar open of day d+1 if present, else the h=0 bar open of day d+1 counted as lag-exit-at-next-midnight, else the close of the latest bar on day d counted as lag-early-exit-last-bar, else the position is absent from the lagged series); the funding-crossing count; yearly and quarterly means; and leg gross means are reported for reading the result and may not be used to promote, rescue, reinterpret, pool, or extend the claim under any outcome.

gate_descriptions.G1_net_magnitude: mean over included dates of spread_d >= 0.0005 (5 bps per date per dollar of gross exposure)
gate_descriptions.G2_leg_contribution: mean long_excess_d > 0 and mean short_excess_d > 0 (each leg beats the equal-weight eligible universe after its own fees)
gate_descriptions.G3_quarter_stability: quarters with at least one included date; positive_quarters * 5 >= included_quarters * 3 (exact rational three-fifths rule)
gate_descriptions.G4_dependence_robustness: one-sided circular block bootstrap of the date series spread_d (block 7 dates, 20,000 replicates, seed 20260902): p = (1 + #{resampled mean <= 0}) / 20,001 < alpha_4 = 0.0025
gate_descriptions.conjunction: All four gates must be true for a window to pass. Gates are evaluated only when the minimum sample is met.

result.reason: at least one frozen gate is false
